 from __future__ import annotations
 
+import json

+
+_SESSION_ID_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$")

     def load(self, session_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
         raise NotImplementedError
+
+
+class FileSessionStore(SessionStore):
+    """Persists session payloads as JSON files under a private directory.
+
+    Only used for local/dev persistence; each session is written atomically
+    and restricted to owner-only permissions since payloads may carry
+    authentication state.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, directory: str | Path) -> None:
+        self._directory = Path(directory)
+        self._directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        try:
+            os.chmod(self._directory, stat.S_IRWXU)
+        except (NotImplementedError, OSError):
+            pass
+
+    def _path_for(self, session_id: str) -> Path:
+        if not _SESSION_ID_RE.match(session_id):
+            raise ValueError(f"invalid session_id: {session_id!r}")
+        return self._directory / f"{session_id}.json"
+
+    def save(self, session_id: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        path = self._path_for(session_id)
+        tmp_path = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
+        tmp_path.write_text(json.dumps(payload), encoding="utf-8")
+        try:
+            os.chmod(tmp_path, stat.S_IRUSR | stat.S_IWUSR)
+        except (NotImplementedError, OSError):
+            pass
+        os.replace(tmp_path, path)
+
+    def load(self, session_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+        path = self._path_for(session_id)
+        if not path.exists():
+            return None
+        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
